pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ shū jiāohuán jiǎn lǎoshī , huí ménfáng shí , zhuōshàng yòu duō le yìfēngxìn .
pairs.english: Tavi returned the book to Instructor Jian; back at the gatehouse, an additional letter had appeared on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把书交还简老师，回门房时，桌上又多了一封信。

pairs.target: búshì yú shīfu zhéhuílái bǔ huà , shìcóng huī ào sònglái de , fēngkǒu yā de hěn píng , bèimiàn yǒu bó yà xiě de xiǎozì .
pairs.english: Master Yu hadn't doubled back to add something; this had been sent from Ash Hollow, the seal pressed very flat, with tiny letters on the back in Boya's hand.
pairs.hanzi: 不是虞师傅折回来补话，是从灰坳送来的，封口压得很平，背面有博娅写的小字。

pairs.target: tā xiān kàn le rìqī , cái chāikāi .
pairs.english: He checked the date first, then opened it.
pairs.hanzi: 他先看了日期，才拆开。

pairs.target: sè lā yǐjīng shōudào nà fēng chū ménqián xiě de duǎnxìn , wèn tā bànrì jiūjìng zǒu dào le shénme dìfāng .
pairs.english: Sela had already received the short letter written before his departure and asked where exactly he had walked in half a day.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉已经收到那封出门前写的短信，问他半日究竟走到了什么地方。

pairs.target: tā shuō běibiān nàme dà , gébì màicài de yě tiāntiān wǎng běibiān zǒu , huílái zhǐ shuō tuǐsuān , méi shuō jiàn guò shénme dà shìmiàn .
pairs.english: She said the north was vast; the vegetable seller next door went north every day too, and returned complaining only of aching legs, not of having seen the great world.
pairs.hanzi: 她说北边那么大，隔壁卖菜的也天天往北边走，回来只说腿酸，没说见过什么大世面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòzài ménbiān , kàndào zhèlǐ xiào chū le shēng .
pairs.english: Sitting by the door, Tavi laughed aloud at this.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在门边，看到这里笑出了声。

pairs.target: xìn wǎng xià xiě , sè lā bǎ jiālǐ de pén huàn le gè dìfāng , búzài zhènghǎo lán zhe guò dào , línjū què háishì ràoyuǎn , shuō jiǎo yǐjīng jìshú le .
pairs.english: The letter went on: Sela had moved the basin at home, no longer directly blocking the passage; yet the neighbour still detoured, saying his feet already knew the way.
pairs.hanzi: 信往下写，瑟拉把家里的盆换了个地方，不再正好拦着过道，邻居却还是绕远，说脚已经记熟了。

pairs.target: tā de xīgài réngjiù tiānyīn shí nánshòu , qíngtiān biàn bān zhāng dèngzi zuò dào ménwài , gēn lùguò de rén jiǎng liǎngjù xiánhuà .
pairs.english: Her knees still hurt in cloudy weather; on fine days she took a stool to sit outside and exchanged a little chatter with people passing by.
pairs.hanzi: 她的膝盖仍旧天阴时难受，晴天便搬张凳子坐到门外，跟路过的人讲两句闲话。

pairs.target: bó yà tì tā xiě dào zhèlǐ , lìng zài pángbiān tiān le yíjù , shuō tā zuò zhe zhǐhuī rén nuó pén , dào yìdiǎn bù xiánlèi .
pairs.english: Boya, writing for her here, added another comment in the margin, saying she sat directing people to move basins, yet didn't find it tiring at all.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅替她写到这里，另在旁边添了一句，说她坐着指挥人挪盆，倒一点不嫌累。

pairs.target: sè lā bùkěn bǎ nà jù huàdiào , huí le yíjù , shuō huì xiězì de rén zuì ài chèn biérén kànbújiàn tiān huà .
pairs.english: Sela refused to cross the line out, replying that people who could write most loved adding words when others couldn't see.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉不肯把那句划掉，回了一句，说会写字的人最爱趁别人看不见添话。

pairs.target: liǎngjùhuà jǐ zài tóng yìbiān , mòwěi hái bǔ zhe yígè xiǎoxiǎode xiàoliǎn .
pairs.english: The two remarks crowded the same margin, with a tiny smiling face added at the end.
pairs.hanzi: 两句话挤在同一边，末尾还补着一个小小的笑脸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe nà xiàoliǎn , kàn le hěn jiǔ , cái jìxù wǎngxiàdú .
pairs.english: Tavi stared at that smiling face, looking for a long time before he continued reading.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着那笑脸，看了很久，才继续往下读。

pairs.target: tā méi wèn tā zhèhuí zhèng le duōshǎo , yě méi jiào tā bǎ qián quán dàihuíqù .
pairs.english: She hadn't asked how much he'd earned this time, or told him to bring all the money home.
pairs.hanzi: 她没问他这回挣了多少，也没叫他把钱全带回去。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ shuō xiàcì ruò háiyào zǒu yuǎn , bié děng yǐjīng zài lùshang , cái xiǎngqǐ gàosù jiālǐ .
pairs.english: She only said if he went far again next time, not to wait until he was already on the road before remembering to tell home.
pairs.hanzi: 她只说下次若还要走远，别等已经在路上，才想起告诉家里。

pairs.target: xiàmiàn yìháng zì xiě de hěn zhòng : búshì yào nǐ bú qù .
pairs.english: A line of writing below was heavily emphasised: she was not asking him not to go.
pairs.hanzi: 下面一行字写得很重：不是要你不去。

pairs.target: tā yòng shǒuzhǐ yāzhù nà yìháng , xiàng pà fēng bǎ tā fānguòqù .
pairs.english: He held that line down with a finger, as though afraid the wind would turn it over.
pairs.hanzi: 他用手指压住那一行，像怕风把它翻过去。

pairs.target: ménfáng wèn shìbushì jiālǐ chū le shì , tā yáotóu , shuō méiyǒu , dōu shì xiē xiǎoshì .
pairs.english: The gatekeeper asked whether something had happened at home; he shook his head, saying no, only little things.
pairs.hanzi: 门房问是不是家里出了事，他摇头，说没有，都是些小事。

pairs.target: zhèhuà shuōwán , tā yòu bǎ xìn dú le yíbiàn , juéde " xiǎoshì " shuō de bú dà tuǒdàng , què yě bù zhīdào gāi huànchéng shénme .
pairs.english: After saying this he read the letter once again, feeling “little things” wasn't quite right, yet not knowing what to call them instead.
pairs.hanzi: 这话说完，他又把信读了一遍，觉得“小事”说得不大妥当，却也不知道该换成什么。

pairs.target: pà wò xiàlóu qǔ dōngxī , kànjiàn tā shǒu zhe xìn , biàn méi xiàng wǎngcháng nàyàng xiān qiǎng yíjù wánxiào .
pairs.english: Pavo came downstairs to collect something, saw him sitting with the letter, and didn't rush in with a joke first as usual.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃下楼取东西，看见他守着信，便没像往常那样先抢一句玩笑。

pairs.target: tā zài ménbiān zhàn le huìer , wèn tǎ wéi míngrì xiàkè lái bu lái tīng chànggē , jǐgè yǐqián yìqǐ chàng guò de rén yuē zài xiǎo yuànlǐ chī dòuzi .
pairs.english: He stood by the door a while and asked whether Tavi would come hear singing after class tomorrow; some people who'd sung together before had arranged to eat beans in the little yard.
pairs.hanzi: 他在门边站了会儿，问塔维明日下课来不来听唱歌，几个以前一起唱过的人约在小院里吃豆子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn zìjǐ yào dài shénme .
pairs.english: Tavi asked what he should bring.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问自己要带什么。

pairs.target: " dài zuǐ . "
pairs.english: “Bring your mouth.”
pairs.hanzi: “带嘴。”

pairs.target: pà wò shuōwán , yòu tiān yíjù , ruò shì néngdài wǎn yěhǎo , tāmen shàng cìshǔ cuò le .
pairs.english: After speaking, Pavo added that if he could bring a bowl too, that would be good; they'd miscounted last time.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说完，又添一句，若是能带碗也好，他们上次数错了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuōhǎo , wèn háiyǒu méiyǒu shuí huì lái .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed and asked who else might come.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说好，问还有没有谁会来。

pairs.target: pà wò bào le jǐgè rén de míngzì , shuō yīwén yě zhīdào , zhìyú mǐlā , yào kàn tā de tú gǎi wán méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Pavo gave a few people's names, said Iven knew too; as for Mira, it depended on whether she'd finished revising her drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃报了几个人的名字，说伊文也知道，至于米拉，要看她的图改完没有。

pairs.target: tā ná le dōngxī biàn zǒu , méi bǎ tǎ wéi de dāying dàngchéng tì biérén yě dāying .
pairs.english: He took his things and left, without treating Tavi's acceptance as an answer for anyone else too.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿了东西便走，没把塔维的答应当成替别人也答应。

pairs.target: nàwǎn tǎ wéi xiě huíxìn , méiyǒu xiān xiě kèdù , yě méiyǒu huà nà liǎngtiáo hóngxiàn .
pairs.english: That evening Tavi wrote a reply, without starting with the graduations or drawing those two red lines.
pairs.hanzi: 那晚塔维写回信，没有先写刻度，也没有画那两条红线。

pairs.target: tā huà le běi ménwài yíduàn càiqí , xiě shuǐ cóng shíqiáng biān liúguòqù , yǒu gè nǚrén tí zhe kōngtǒng , gēn děng chuán de rén chǎo wán , hái děi zhàn zhe děng zìjǐ de bàntǒngshuǐ .
pairs.english: He drew some vegetable beds outside the north gate and wrote of water flowing past the stone wall, a woman with an empty bucket who, after arguing with a man waiting for a boat, still had to stand waiting for her own half-bucket of water.
pairs.hanzi: 他画了北门外一段菜畦，写水从石墙边流过去，有个女人提着空桶，跟等船的人吵完，还得站着等自己的半桶水。

pairs.target: xiě dào zhèlǐ , tā xiǎng le xiǎng , bǎ " bàntǒng " huàdiào , gǎichéng děng qiánmiàn nà jiā qǔ wán .
pairs.english: At that point he thought, crossed out “half a bucket,” and changed it to waiting for the household ahead to finish collecting.
pairs.hanzi: 写到这里，他想了想，把“半桶”划掉，改成等前面那家取完。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào tā zuìhòu qǔ le duōshǎo , bùxiǎng bǎ zìjǐ tīngjiàn de bàntǒng ān dào tā shǒulǐ .
pairs.english: He didn't know how much she eventually took, and didn't want to put the half-bucket he'd heard about into her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 他不知道她最后取了多少，不想把自己听见的半桶安到她手里。

pairs.target: tā yòu xiě yú shīfu yǎo suān guǒ de yàngzi , xiě zìjǐ xué zhe wěnzhù liǎngshǒu , què réngjiù yǒu zuò bù wán de shíhòu .
pairs.english: He also wrote the scene of Master Yu biting sour fruit, and wrote how he himself was learning to steady both hands, but still there were times he could not finish.
pairs.hanzi: 他又写虞师傅咬酸果的样子，写自己学着稳住两手，却仍旧有做不完的时候。

pairs.target: guānyú nài lěi xià yìchéng , tā zhǐ xiě hái méiyǒu wènqīng , děng yǒu le shízài de rìzi hé qùchù , huì zài gàosù tā .
pairs.english: About Nerai's next journey, he only wrote that he hadn't asked clearly yet, and would tell her again once there were definite dates and a destination.
pairs.hanzi: 关于奈蕾下一程，他只写还没有问清，等有了实在的日子和去处，会再告诉她。

pairs.target: xiě wán hòu , tā bǎ yuán xìn zhé hǎo , fàngdào zìjǐ de jiù xìn pángbiān , huíxìn liúzài zhuōshàng liàng mò .
pairs.english: After writing, he folded the original letter and put it beside his old letters, leaving the reply on the table for the ink to dry.
pairs.hanzi: 写完后，他把原信折好，放到自己的旧信旁边，回信留在桌上晾墨。

pairs.target: mò gān de hěn màn , tā méiyǒu náshǒu qù shì , xiān qù bǎ míngrì dài qù de wǎn xǐ le .
pairs.english: The ink dried slowly; instead of testing it with a hand, he first went to wash the bowl he would take tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 墨干得很慢，他没有拿手去试，先去把明日带去的碗洗了。
